answer: Mirror duty: each epoch the beacon hands every identity one sentence quoted from a random stranger's last answer, and its essay must open by testing that claim. Graders score whether the critique engages the quote; a generic opener earns 0. Critiques hang on a public trellis under their target, so a farm can't reuse one text: 1,000 clones face 1,000 different quotes. Assuming ~4,000 tokens at $3 per million, every clone pays about $0.012 of real inference per epoch, so cost grows with head count, and an opal mark comes only after 20 graded critiques.
